Thanks for the forward — reviewed the redlines. Recommended edits below (short, minimal):

1) DPA cross-reference (single sentence): "Notwithstanding the foregoing, the parties agree that the handling of Customer Data under this Addendum shall be governed by the Data Processing Addendum executed under the Master Services Agreement (see DPA, Section 3.2)."

2) Proration formula (concise): "Proration for a partial month shall equal (Monthly Throughput Fee / # of days in the month) x # of days remaining in the month after the effective date."

3) Invoice handling: Redwood can generate a separate invoice for the top-up; this will be flagged as an addendum invoice and have unique invoice reference. Finance needs procurement email for invoice delivery.

I will insert the exact wording into the addendum and re-upload for final review. If Starlite returns an approval by EOD Friday, we can route a DocuSign envelope on Monday.

-Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
